summary.headline: Neapolitan Codex Astronomical Entries
summary.text: Catalogue of Neapolitan codex entries on celestial spheres, heaven, planets, the Sun, winds, zodiacal signs, climates, elements, stellar risings and settings, and planetary influences, with folio references and diagrams. Authorities include Proclus, Antiochus, Paul of Alexandria, Julian of Laodicea, and Claudius Ptolemy.
